EngBench

Engineering design tasks graded by deterministic solvers, never by an LLM. Single-shot: one answer, no tools, the engineer answering cold. Agentic: a Python tool to compute and self-check, and a test lab: each submitted design comes back with a test and review report of what failed (a fuse ruptured in the short-circuit test, the plant could not charge in winter), never the cause or the numbers, and the design passes if it clears the tests within three rounds. It measures whether the model can find the root cause of its own mistakes and fix them without breaking something else. The first-design rate is shown beside it. Cell footnotes are the number of task runs behind each rate.

143 tasks · 2466 task runs · 3 models · updated 2026-11-03 07:28 UTC

Leaderboard

Score out of 100: six levels, each worth published points (15, 20, 15, 20, 15, 15), earned at that level's pass rate; agentic counts a pass within three test rounds. Levels 3 and 4 are scored on held-out seeds that are not published (so they cannot leak into training); the public tasks of those levels below are the same generator, for reproduction. Levels a model has not run earn nothing, so compare scores only across the same levels run.

Tokens and cost

Every graded task run, public and held-out, as a release check runs them (3 trials). Input tokens include cached prompt reads, which cost far less than fresh input; a provider without prompt caching pays full price on all of them. Cost is what the transport reports: for claude-cli the API-equivalent price, billed to the subscription. Budget a new model from cost per task run times the task runs.

By family

The first three families (mechanical fit, DC circuits, and their combination) are saturated and stay as a floor. The generated families ask for a design within 5% of the brute-force optimum, not just a feasible one.

The gBat 400 A string fuse (the only 1500 V fuse rating with a time constant of at least the 5 ms circuit L/R) exceeds the derated C-95 ampacity of about 237 A (362 A x 0.91 at 40 C x 0.72 for 6 circuits per tray).",
   "reason": "Under 433.3.1 b), overload protection may be omitted where a conductor is not likely to carry overload current, has no branch circuits, and is protected against short circuit. Each cable is a single point-to-point string-to-PCS circuit with no branches. The 1500 V, 10 ms, 200 kA gBat fuse clears every short-circuit current, from about 3.3 kA (end of life, 5% SOC) to about 35 kA (bus-fed), within the cable k2S2 withstand (143^2 x 95^2 = 1.8e8 A2s)."
  }
 ]

 "requirements": [
  {
   "id": "R-SOC",
   "parent": "SN-1",
   "value": 2.97,
   "unit": "%",
   "basis": "Gross window energy is 4.9311+0.071=5.0021 MWh over 90%. Meeting 4.6 MWh net needs (4.6+0.071)/5.0021*90 = 84.04% window. The error eats both ends, so e <= (90-84.04)/2 = 2.97%."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-TRIP",
   "parent": "SN-4",
   "value": 150,
   "unit": "ms",
   "basis": "Cell safety limit: above 3.75 V the cell must be disconnected within 150 ms. Budget = 6 scans worst case + MCU cycle + contactor opening."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-PRE",
   "parent": "SN-3",
   "value": 9.5,
   "unit": "s",
   "basis": "Bus ready within 10 s minus the 0.5 s start sequence. Precharge time is 3RC to reach 5% of string voltage, with one string charging the 2.4 mF link alone."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-BAL",
   "parent": "SN-4",
   "value": 90,
   "unit": "mA",
   "basis": "Self-discharge spread at 35 C is 1.72%/month of 314 Ah = 5.40 Ah/month = 0.18 Ah/day, recovered in the 2 h/day balancing window."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-BRK",
   "parent": "SN-4",
   "value": 940,
   "unit": "A",
   "basis": "The gBat 250 A fuse pre-arc curve stays slower than the cell short-time limit up to about 940 A (about 3 C). The contactor must break every current below that crossover."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-RIDE",
   "parent": [
    "SN-6",
    "SN-4"
   ],
   "value": 2.04,
   "unit": "s",
   "basis": "Voltage is below 50% from t=0 to 2.059 s: dip, reclose at 26% at 0.75 s, second dip, then linear recovery to 50% at 1.0+1.059 s. The PSU's own 20 ms hold-up gives 2.039 s."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-IMD",
   "parent": [
    "SN-4",
    "SN-6"
   ],
   "value": 149.2,
   "unit": "uF",
   "basis": "Transformerless PCS on a shared unearthed winding make one IT system, so one IMD sees 19*1.52 + 4*30 + 19*80 m*0.19 nF = 149.17 uF."
  }
 ],

   "parent": "SN-3",
   "value": 9.5,
   "unit": "s",

  },

   "basis": "Gross energy over the 10-90% window is 4.0522+0.0317=4.0839 MWh. A 1 h, 2.2 MWh delivery needs 2.2317 MWh gross, which is 43.72% of SOC. That leaves (80-43.72)/2 = 18.1% of error per end. Assumptions: energy is linear in SOC, the 0.0317 MWh auxiliary energy is a fixed 1 h overhead, and no extra FCR margin beyond 1.8 MW x 0.25 h each direction. The design budget is 11.0% (CS-10 offset over 240 h) + 5.5% (AFE-3 at 0.6 mV/% near 90%) + 0.4% (gain) + 0.9% (self-discharge spread) = 17.8%."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-TRIP",
   "parent": "SN-4",
   "value": 200,
   "unit": "ms",
   "basis": "Cell safety limit: disconnect within 200 ms above 3.75 V. The design gives 6 x (2.37+13 x 1.0) ms scans + 5 ms control cycle + 30 ms contactor opening, about 127 ms."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-PRE",
   "parent": "SN-3",
   "value": 9.5,
   "unit": "s",
   "basis": "Bus ready within 10 s minus the 0.5 s start sequence. With 220 ohm on 7.9 mF, precharge to 95% takes 3RC = 5.2 s."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-BAL",
   "parent": "SN-1",
   "value": 46,
   "unit": "mA",
   "basis": "Self-discharge spread is 2.72%/month at 35 C, i.e. 8.3 Ah/month on 306 Ah (beginning-of-life worst case). That is 0.277 Ah/day, recovered in 6 h of balancing per day."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-BRK",
   "parent": "SN-4",
   "value": 2530,
   "unit": "A",
   "basis": "The gBat 400 A pre-arcing curve (log-log interpolation) crosses the cell short-time limit (1C = 306 A) at about 2530 A. Below that the fuse is too slow, so the contactor must break."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-RIDE",
   "parent": [
    "SN-6",
    "SN-4"
   ],

   "unit": "s",
   "basis": "Auxiliary voltage follows the grid: 150 ms at 15%, then +50%/s, so it is below 70% for 1.25 s per dip. Subtract the 20 ms PSU hold-up. The sequence has two dips; HB-2 is sized for both without recharge (about 10.8 W x 2.46 s = 27 J)."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-IMD",
   "parent": [
    "SN-4",
    "SN-6"
   ],
   "value": 84.1,
   "unit": "uF",
   "basis": "One unearthed IT system through the transformerless PCS: 15 x 1.58 + 2 x 30 + 15 x 80 m x 2 x 0.17 nF = 84.1 uF. Only one IMD is allowed per IT system."
  }
 ],

{
 "requirements": [
  {
   "id": "R-SOC",
   "parent": "SN-1",
   "value": 5.92,
   "unit": "%",
   "basis": "Gross energy 3.8924+0.1085=4.0009 MWh over the 80% window. Needed gross is 3.300+0.1085=3.4085 MWh, which is 68.15% of window, leaving (80-68.15)/2=5.92% error at each end. Check with chosen parts: AFE-3 3.21 mV / 2.4 mV/% (OCV slope 90-95%) = 1.34%; CS-1 offset 0.0399 A x 168 h / 257.6 Ah = 2.60%; gain 0.3% x 80% = 0.24%; self-discharge spread over 7 d at 30 C = 0.36%; total 4.54%."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-TRIP",
   "parent": "SN-4",
   "value": 150,
   "unit": "ms",
   "basis": "Cell above 3.75 V must be disconnected within 150 ms. Check: AFE-3, 2 chains of 13 chips at 15.3 ms per scan; 5 scans = 76 ms, plus up to 2 MCU-3 cycles (10 ms) and K-1 opening (25 ms) = about 111 ms."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-PRE",
   "parent": "SN-3",
   "value": 7.0,
   "unit": "s",
   "basis": "8 s to bus ready minus the 1 s start sequence. Check: closing at 2% takes ln(50) x R x 12.6 mF = 4.93 s with 100 ohm; peak current 1460 V / 100 ohm = 14.6 A, within the relay's 50 A."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-BAL",
   "parent": [
    "SN-1",
    "SN-4"
   ],
   "value": 66.2,
   "unit": "mA",
   "basis": "Self-discharge spread at 30 C is 1.09 x 2^0.5 = 1.54%/month. That is 1.54% x 257.6 Ah / 30 d = 0.132 Ah/day, recovered in 2 h/day = 66.2 mA. AFE-3 internal balancing gives 150 mA."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-BRK",
   "parent": "SN-4",
   "value": 1413,
   "unit": "A",
   "basis": "The fuse pre-arcing curve falls below the cell short-time limit (1 C = 314 A) only from about 1413 A upward (log-log crossover between 4x and 5x In). Below that the contactor must break, so K-1 (1500 A) is enough."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-RIDE",
   "parent": [
    "SN-6",
    "SN-2"
   ],
   "value": 2.38,
   "unit": "s",
   "basis": "Supply is below 60%: 0.15 s dip, 0.3 s recovery to 22.5%, 0.15 s dip, then 1.8 s at 25%/s back to 60% = 2.40 s. Minus the PSU's 20 ms hold-up = 2.38 s. Rack load 9.2 W x 2.38 s = 21.9 J, so HB-2 (50 J)."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-IMD",
   "parent": [
    "SN-4",
    "SN-6"
   ],
   "value": 102.15,
   "unit": "uF",
   "basis": "One galvanically connected IT system (transformerless PCS, unearthed star point), so one IMD for the whole system. Capacitance: 16 x 0.75 + 2 x 45 + 16 x 25 m x 2 x 0.19 nF = 102.15 uF."
  }
 ],

{
 "requirements": [
  {
   "id": "R-SOC",
   "parent": "SN-1",
   "value": 14.3,
   "unit": "%",
   "basis": "Each end of the 10-90% window gives up the SOC error. Need 2.300 + 0.0724 = 2.3724 MWh out of 3.6213 + 0.0724 = 3.6937 MWh, which is 64.2% of the 80-point span. Allowed error \u2248 (80 - 51.4) / 2 \u2248 14.3% (OCV-weighted gives the same). Design budget with AFE-3 + CS-2: OCV reset at 90% within \u00b13.45 mV \u2248 8.75%, offset 0.0856 A \u00d7 120 h / 220.9 Ah \u2248 4.65%, gain 0.24%, self-discharge spread 0.28%; total 13.9%."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-TRIP",
   "parent": "SN-4",
   "value": 150,
   "unit": "ms",
   "basis": "Cell above 3.75 V must be disconnected within 150 ms. Design worst case: 4 scans \u00d7 15.3 ms + 10 ms MCU cycle + 30 ms K-2 opening \u2248 101 ms (\u2248 148 ms even if the two chains are scanned one after the other)."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-PRE",
   "parent": "SN-3",
   "value": 7.0,
   "unit": "s",
   "basis": "8 s to DC bus ready minus the 1 s start sequence leaves 7 s. Reaching 2% takes 3.91\u00b7R\u00b7C, so R \u2264 373 \u03a9 with C = 4.8 mF. The 30 A relay sets R \u2265 1343.2 / 30 = 44.8 \u03a9."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-BAL",
   "parent": "SN-1",
   "value": 19.4,
   "unit": "mA",
   "basis": "Self-discharge spread at 35 \u00b0C: 1.66% \u00d7 280 Ah = 4.65 Ah per month. Correcting that in 30 days \u00d7 8 h of balancing needs 19.4 mA."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-BRK",
   "parent": "SN-4",
   "value": 2750,
   "unit": "A",
   "basis": "The 400 A gBat fuse only clears faster than the cell short-time limit above about 2750 A (log-log crossing between 5x and 7x, near 10 C). Below that, the contactor must break the current."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-RIDE",
   "parent": [
    "SN-6",
    "SN-4"
   ],
   "value": 2.21,
   "unit": "s",
   "basis": "In the dip-reclose-dip sequence the voltage stays below 70% from t = 0 until 0.7 + 1.529 = 2.229 s. Subtracting the PSU's own 20 ms hold-up leaves 2.209 s to bridge. At 10.2 W this needs 22.5 J, so HB-2 (50 J)."
  },
  {
   "id": "R-IMD",
   "parent": [
    "SN-4",
    "SN-6"
   ],
   "value": 72.4,
   "unit": "uF",
   "basis": "Transformerless PCS on an unearthed common winding make the whole plant one IT system, so only one IMD is allowed. Leakage capacitance: 19 \u00d7 1.67 + 4 \u00d7 10 + 19 \u00d7 2 \u00d7 80 m \u00d7 0.23 nF/m = 72.4 uF."
  }
 ],
